implementation: Share immutable source ownership, options, source/point picking, temporary portions and commit policy with InsertKink.
One local checkpoint per manual/Automatic action; document geometry and existing Undo/Redo stay unchanged until Enter.
Retain polycurve segments with NURBS leaves and global parameter charts.
Automatic bisects unique active spans. Surface Direction follows the isocurve; explicit parameter-axis scripting remains separate.
Use selected-backend exact curve/tensor refinement for standalone surfaces and single-face B-reps. Retain B-rep topology, degrees and UV domains without boundary refitting.
Reuse a geometrically coincident station for implicit mirror insertion, preventing duplicate knots at a rational midpoint.

audit_log_note: A parallel native UI test progress message interrupted one symmetry JSON line. The raw full log is retained; per-case native UI symmetry errors use the additional complete serial 19-case run. No reference data was changed.

regression.before: Six controls instead of the native five because reflection straddled the projected midpoint by an ulp.
regression.after: One knot and five controls; all 19 symmetry records pass through both API/UI backends.

limits: No arbitrary command equivalence, continuous error certificate, complete workspace test run or general performance benchmark is claimed.
The two unused outer NURBS knots use the importer convention; active knots, controls, weights, domains and recorded samples are compared.
Native event statuses are retained. Rust Result<String> does not expose the full Rhino Cancel/Failure enum; comparisons cover physical output, geometry metadata, selection and history.
Native metadata-only Undo/Redo was not captured; local metadata edits remain normal document history.
Temporary-portion captures use endpoints. Numeric shortening inherits the shared getter and has no new InsertKnot-specific native capture.
No new edited-3dm roundtrip matrix, complete preference workflow, status-panel/pixel parity, block-member or polysurface qualification.
Guide display is bounded to 4096 curve markers and 1024 isocurves per direction.
Prior InsertKink getter precision/circle differences and the invalid-native-curve guard remain explicit in the earlier receipt.
